claims: The Artemis II mission is set for April 2025.
Artemis II will fly four astronauts around the Moon and back to Earth.
Artemis II is the first crewed flight test of the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and Orion spacecraft.
Artemis II validates life-support systems with astronauts for deep space travel.
Artemis II will test the Orion spacecraft's environmental control and life-support systems (power, propulsion, and crew safety) with a human crew for the first time.
Artemis II will fly astronauts further into space than ever before.
Artemis II will venture into deep Earth orbit and around the Moon.
Artemis II serves as a bridge between the uncrewed Artemis I and future lunar surface missions.
Artemis II will gather essential data on radiation shielding and human performance.
Artemis II will gather data on the safety of female astronauts.
The Artemis II crew features astronauts from NASA and the Canadian Space Agency.
Artemis II highlights international partnership with ESA, JAXA, and the UAE.
The Artemis II crew will perform detailed observations of the lunar surface.
The Artemis II crew observations target geological features to guide future landing spots near the South Pole.
Artemis II will prove that space technologies are safe for long-duration human spaceflight beyond low-Earth orbit.
